mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact two-fluid co-Plummer Newtonian equilibrium using a chosen inverse charged EOS, and a conserved-mass finite-inertia negative coupled radial energy direction for every critical-charge positive-compressibility member with 0<f<=1/1000.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy symbolic real functions and rational interval arithmetic; independent 60-digit mpmath quadrature.
mathematics.conventions: Newtonian rest-mass gravity, two conserved actual currents with varied total rest-mass frame; rationalized gauge units; critical q/m=sqrt(4 pi G); normalized radial Q units GM^2/b.

bounds.radial_trial: One explicit fixed finite-inertia rational mass trial, analytic inequalities cover the declared family.
bounds.interval_bounds: Machin arctangent sums with 24 terms; rational sqrt6 enclosure to 30 decimals; rational sqrt6 atan series 18 terms.
bounds.quadrature: One assigned witness f=1/1000 q0=1/400; 60-digit quadrature, no interval integration claim.
bounds.resources: 45 seconds wall, 35 CPU seconds, one numerical-library thread.

non_claims: Chosen inverse EOS is not derived microphysics.
Negative energy defeats positive-energy closure; no full PDE spectral-domain theorem is proved.
No full Einstein, population, vacuum phase, cosmology or empirical closure.
